statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir' | sed "s|$HOME|~|g"); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); time=$(date +%H:%M); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); transcript=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path'); todo_count=$([ -f "$transcript" ] && grep -c '"type":"todo"' "$transcript" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); cd "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')" 2>/dev/null; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); dirty=''; [ -n "$branch" ] && [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] && dirty='✗'; AR='\033[1;32m'; CY='\033[0;36m'; BL='\033[1;34m'; RD='\033[0;31m'; YL='\033[0;33m'; MG='\033[0;35m'; DM='\033[2;37m'; RS='\033[0m'; printf "${AR}➜${RS}  ${CY}${cwd}${RS}"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf "  ${BL}git:(${RD}${branch}${BL})${YL}${dirty}${RS}"; [ -n "$remaining" ] && printf "  ${MG}ctx:${remaining}%%${RS}"; printf "  ${DM}${model}${RS}  ${YL}${time}${RS}"; [ "$todo_count" -gt 0 ] && printf "  ${CY}todos:${todo_count}${RS}"; echo
